title: Moses and the Presence of God

questions.question: Where did Moses pitch the tent of meeting?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:7 (ESV): "Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far off from the camp."

questions.question: What did Moses ask God to show him?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:18 (ESV): "Moses said, 'Please show me your glory.'"

questions.question: How did God speak with Moses?
options: Face to face, as a man speaks to his friend
questions.correctAnswer: Face to face, as a man speaks to his friend
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:11 (ESV): "The Lord used to speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend."

questions.question: What stood at the entrance of the tent when Moses entered?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:9 (ESV): "When Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance."

questions.question: What did God tell the people to remove as a sign of mourning?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:5 (ESV): "Now therefore take off your ornaments, that I may know what to do with you."

questions.question: What did Moses say would distinguish Israel from all other peoples?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:16 (ESV): "Is it not in your going with us, so that we are distinct, I and your people, from every other people on the face of the earth?"

questions.question: What did God say Moses could not see and live?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:20 (ESV): "You cannot see my face, for man shall not see me and live."

questions.question: Where did God place Moses to protect him while His glory passed by?
options: In a cleft of the rock and covered him with His hand
questions.correctAnswer: In a cleft of the rock and covered him with His hand
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:22 (ESV): "I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and I will cover you with my hand until I have passed by."

questions.question: What part of God would Moses see?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:23 (ESV): "Then I will take away my hand, and you shall see my back, but my face shall not be seen."

questions.question: What did God say about knowing Moses?
options: I know you by name, and you have found favor in my sight
questions.correctAnswer: I know you by name, and you have found favor in my sight
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:17 (ESV): "I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight."

questions.question: Why did God initially say He would not go up in their midst?
options: Lest He consume them on the way, for they were a stiff-necked people
questions.correctAnswer: Lest He consume them on the way, for they were a stiff-necked people
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:3 (ESV): "I will not go up among you, lest I consume you on the way, for you are a stiff-necked people."

questions.question: What did God promise to make pass before Moses?
options: All His goodness and proclaim His name
questions.correctAnswer: All His goodness and proclaim His name
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:19 (ESV): "I will make all my goodness pass before you and will proclaim before you my name 'The Lord.'"

questions.question: What did God say about mercy and grace?
options: I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and show mercy on whom I will show mercy
questions.correctAnswer: I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and show mercy on whom I will show mercy
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:19 (ESV): "I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy."

questions.question: Who stayed in the tent of meeting when Moses returned to camp?
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:11 (ESV): "His assistant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent."

questions.question: What did Moses ask God to consider?
options: That this nation is your people
questions.correctAnswer: That this nation is your people
questions.explanation: Exodus 33:13 (ESV): "Consider too that this nation is your people."

key_verse_text: And he said, 'My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.'
